mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of the instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.2 percentage points from the previous month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% year-over-year), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive returns over the next 20 trading days as strong manufacturing activity supports corporate profits and economic expansion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of the instances when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) from the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of the instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential investment (RSAFS) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (as measured by GDP growth above 2.5% annualized), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive returns over the next 20 trading days due to robust corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of the instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% annualized, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.1 percentage points from the previous month signals an imminent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
